role: Actionable-steps half of AnalysisSummaryGenerator: post-exercise replacement steps, push gating (HRV signals + TrainingAdviceGate load), trend/training-load/score-band steps, morning-feeling divergence and per-tag advice; plus PostExerciseCopy and FeelingCopy sentence enums.
types: AnalysisSummaryGenerator.PushGates: struct — signals deciding whether push advice is safe
PostExerciseCopy: enum — readiness-band sentences after a workout
FeelingCopy: enum — morning-feeling / tag advice sentences
toplevel: No top-level code beyond the type declarations. Magic gates inline: post-exercise when readiness < score-15 and todayTrimp >= 20 (line 31); high relative HRV push when rmssdPct > 15 and score >= 70 (174); feeling divergence hrvGood = score >= 65 (372); sleep efficiency >= 90 (218, 309); readiness <30/<50 session bands (440-441).

flags.text: Push/blocked advice is emitted twice for the same night: appendTrendSteps (rmssdPct > 15, score >= 70) appends 'This is a great day to push yourself…' or a blocked reason, and appendScoreSteps (score >= 80) appends 'Great day for high-intensity training…' or appendBlockedPushReason's near-identical blocked reason (e.g. two different cumulative-load sentences, or loadHoldReason twice), so the steps list repeats the same verdict.
Several inline magic thresholds (15-point readiness gap, TRIMP 20, rmssdPct 15, score 70, feeling score 65, efficiency 90, readiness 30/50) instead of named constants beside HRVThresholds.

units.does: Steps list: if currentReadiness exists, headlineScore >= 60, readiness < score-15 and todayTrimp >= 20 → post-exercise steps only; else trend steps, training-load steps, score-band steps, then feeling steps inserted at the top.

branches.cond: currentReadiness set, score >= 60, readiness < score-15, todayTrimp >= 20
branches.effect: return postExerciseSteps (morning steps and feeling advice dropped); else morning steps

units.does: True when the TrainingAdviceGate level is .easier.
Gate reason sentence when the load level is .holdPush, else nil.

branches.effect: reasonLine (aboveUsual or monotonous sentence); else nil

units.does: Builds PushGates: HRV signals, advice load assessment, and shouldNotPush = short sleep or unstable window or fatigue or sympathetic dominance or not consolidated or load level != clear.
result.isConsolidated, nil treated as false.

Computes RMSSD, stress/LF-HF/DFA (defaulted), window HR CV (default 0), strong vagal tone (pNN50 > 25 and RMSSD >= 40), unstable window (CV > 0.08), fatigue (DFA > 1.35 with strong tone, else > 1.2), sympathetic dominance (LF/HF > 3.0 only without strong tone).

branches.effect: sympathetic dominance forced false; else lfhf > 3.0

units.does: TrainingAdviceGate assessment of the live load snapshot, falling back to the frozen trainingContext (caller's, else result's).

branches.effect: result's frozen context used as the frozen fallback

units.does: Trend steps (needs stats): improving-trend line when trend7Day > 0; high-relative-HRV steps when rmssd > 15% above avg and score >= 70; 'what changed' line when trend7Day < 0.
Appends 'great day to push yourself' when no gate blocks, else the blocked reason.
Blocked reason ordered by safety: cumulative load elevated (easier) sentence; else load hold reason; else today's-night reason.

branches.effect: append the gate's reason line; else appendHighHRVTodayReason

units.does: Today-only blocked reason: not consolidated with no other signal → 'pattern wasn't sustained'; short sleep; unstable window (efficiency >= 90 → 'moderate to high intensity should be fine', else moderate); fatigue; sympathetic dominance.

branches.effect: 'moderate to high intensity should be fine'; else 'moderate intensity' (nil efficiency treated as 0)
'nervous system is still activated'; else nothing appended

units.does: Frozen training context steps: ACR < 0.8 → add movement; else CTL and ATL below ctlThreshold → 20-minute walk.

flags.text: Reads the frozen context, not liveLoadSnapshot, so 'Your training load is low — try adding a walk' can show alongside a live-load hold from the push gate.

units.does: Score-band steps: >=80 well recovered, >=60 adequate, >=40 incomplete, else poor.
Well-recovered: blocked → capacity-without-readiness steps; else push and consolidated lines, plus good-sleep line when isGoodSleep.
Appends the blocked-push reason, then 'Consider moderate activity' when load elevated/held, no strong vagal tone, fatigue or short sleep.

branches.cond: any of cumulativeLoadElevated, loadHoldReason, !strongVagalTone, fatigue, shortSleep

flags.text: With an unstable window, sleep efficiency >= 90 and weak vagal tone, appendUnstableWindowStep says 'you're in good shape for moderate to high intensity' and this then appends 'Consider moderate activity rather than high intensity' — contradictory steps in one list.

units.does: Blocked-push reason for well-recovered scores: cumulative load; load hold reason; not consolidated (no unstable/fatigue/sympathetic); short sleep; unstable window step; fatigue; sympathetic dominance.

branches.effect: 'pattern wasn't held long enough' (short sleep not excluded here, unlike line 213)
'elevated LF/HF ratio — nervous system still activated'; else nothing

flags.text: Ordering differs from appendHighHRVTodayReason: here a short-sleep, unconsolidated night gets 'pattern wasn't held long enough' (line 295 omits !isShortSleep) while line 213 gives the short-sleep reason for the same signals.

units.does: Unstable-window step: efficiency >= 90 → good shape for moderate to high intensity; else not fully consolidated.
Adequate band: moderate-activity line plus short-sleep line or hydration line.

branches.effect: more-sleep line with duration; else hydration/sleep-habits line

units.does: Incomplete band: rest + light movement lines; plus sleep, sleep-quality, slow-breathing (LF/HF > 2.5) and stressor (stress > 200) lines when applicable.
Poor band: take-it-easy line; short-sleep or 'keep today light' line; clinician line when RMSSD < 25; hydration line; fragmented → uninterrupted-sleep line else extra-sleep line.

branches.effect: short-sleep priority line; else keep-light line

units.does: Morning-feeling divergence: feeling <= 2 → tag/generic feel-bad advice inserted at the top; feeling >= 4 with score < 65 → feel-good-HRV-low line at top.

branches.effect: insert feelGoodHRVLow; else nothing (feeling 3 or agreement)

units.does: Low-feeling advice: no tags → generic sentence; else unwell sentence first when .infection tagged, then other tag advice.

flags.text: docs/FLOWCHART.md describes the per-tag advice differently from the code: it says the advice is 'Appended to the analysis summary string' (code inserts it at the top of actionableSteps), 'Allergies → aerobic OK, monitor RHR' (code: 'Training is fine; expect reduced performance', no RHR), and 'Stressed + poor HRV → rest' (code: 'Reduce intensity, keep volume if possible').

units.does: Per-tag sentences in priority order: stomach, hangover, allergies, sore and tired (both skipped when infection tagged), headache, stressed, down.
Post-exercise steps: readiness label on the 0-10 scale, session-cost steps, plus a short-sleep carry-over line.
By readiness: <30 heavy-session steps, <50 moderate-session steps, else light-session copy.
Heavy session: recovery, refuel, avoid-hard-session lines, plus sleep line when not good sleep.

branches.effect: append 8+ hours line (also fires when no sleep data)

units.does: Moderate session: good effort and rest lines, prioritize-sleep line when not good sleep, then skip-intense line.
Avoid-hard-session sentence chosen by the English readiness label.
Light-session pair: 'used some capacity — readiness is now <band>' by English label, plus 'a light session later is possible'.

flags.text: Only reached from sessionCostSteps when readiness >= 50 (toTenScale >= 5.0), where readinessLabel is 'Ready' (>= 7.0) or 'Moderate' (>= 4.5); the Fatigued and default (Rest) cases cannot occur in production.

units.does: Feel-good-but-HRV-low sentence; 'great' for feeling >= 5 else 'good'.
Generic low-feeling sentence: HRV not good → signals agree, rest; else 'terrible' (feeling <= 1) or 'poor'.
Unwell sentence: HRV holding vs suppressed variant, both recommending rest and a doctor if severe.
Stomach-upset sentence.
Hangover sentence: HRV held vs suppressed variant.
Allergies sentence.
Sore sentence: good HRV → train other groups; else full recovery day.
Tired sentence: HRV holding → short session; else easy aerobic day.
Headache sentence.
Stressed sentence: HRV fine → exercise buffers; else reduce intensity.
Low-mood sentence: HRV fine vs suppressed variant, both pointing to someone to talk to.
